AUTHOR: Jalal
TITLE: DeepFins: Capturing dynamics in underwater videos for fish detection
REGION: Australia (OzFish, AIMS); Taiwan coral reefs (Fish4Knowledge / LifeCLEF 2015)
DATA: OzFish (AIMS; 1,758 annotated frames + 8,185 frames newly annotated = 9,943 frames, ~127k boxes); LifeCLEF 2015 (93 annotated videos, Fish4Knowledge stationary cameras)
V_EV: Sec 2.1.1: 'The dataset presents challenges related to luminosity variations, contrast, blurriness, fish camouflage, moving background elements like plants and corals, and water turbidity'
D2: 80/10/10 frames (7,955/994/994); also states an initial 60/20/20 split before merging train+val
D_EV: Sec 2.1.1: 'During the dataset splitting process, it is ensured that frames from the same video are included in only one of the three splits (training, validation, or test) for a fair evaluation.'
R_EV: Table 2: 'Evaluation of model trained on Ozfish training set and tested on LifeCLEF 2015 test set and vice versa.' (DeepFins F1 80.2 / 83.7 vs in-domain OzFish 90.0, Table 1)
C_EV: Sec 3.1: 'At the inference stage, a confidence threshold of 0.6 filters out low-probability detections, prioritizing precision.'
E_EV: Sec 3: 'Fish detection accuracy is measured using the F1 Score' (precision/recall/F1 only; abundance/biomass left for future work)
ARCH: YOLOv11 detector + direction-based-clustering motion segmentation with YOLOv11 fish/non-fish classification head; preferential merging; Y-channel histogram equalisation
METR: Precision, recall, F1; ablation; cross-dataset evaluation
NOTE: D: OzFish split by video ('frames from the same video ... only one of the three splits'); LifeCLEF uses the 'same splitting strategy'. Paper also mentions a 60/20/20 split later (inconsistent with 80/10/10). R: cross-dataset OzFish<->LifeCLEF 2015 (different region, camera system, habitat) -> R1=Y, R2=복수; in-domain OzFish F1 90.0 vs LifeCLEF-trained on OzFish 83.7 -> R3=Y (in-domain LifeCLEF F1 not separately reported). V: turbidity/visibility described only qualitatively; no strata -> V_ALL=P. C: single confidence threshold 0.6, no sensitivity analysis (segmentation size/area thresholds were swept but these are not confidence thresholds); FP discussed; per policy C1=Y alone -> P. Fish/non-fish classifier head is not an open-set/reject mechanism (C4=N). DSHR: public benchmarks used, but the 8,185 added OzFish annotations are not stated as released. PLAT: OzFish = BRUV, LifeCLEF = fixed cameras (paper calls F4K 'stationary cameras'; OzFish platform not described in text).
